## Analysis

The exhaustive modulus-5-to-12 census closes the structural gap identified previously: no uniform periodic residue core in that range, even with twelve optimized boundary rows per side, beats the width-4 incumbent. Combined with failures of phase transitions, block ascent, arbitrary grids, and stochastic multi-level masks, the evidence points to the repeated core itself—not insufficient fringe search—as the limiting factor. Further endpoint polishing or single-mask modulus sweeps are unlikely to help. A remaining unrefuted family is a genuinely heterogeneous core comprising several long periodic segments with different masks.
